items.title: U.S. road trip destinations seeing signs of Canadians staying away
items.content: Tourism destinations in New York’s North Country are an easy destination for road trippers for many central Canadians, but recent inflamed rhetoric has tourism operators fearing a potential loss of millions of dollars.
